intro: Nether-lace Garment marks the completion of tailor Kil'hala's specialized crafting work in the Barrens. By weaving the gathered hair of dryads into refined cloth, the tailor crafts an enchanted garment fit for spellcasters.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here is your nether-lace, friend. It is both comfortable and durable, and holds the magic of the laughing sisters' hair.
Enjoy, and if you find it amenable, please mention so to Deino. She is a mage on whose good side I wish to stay...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
